evidence.title: Pane README
evidence.locator: intro; What Flying Feels Like; Remote Pane; Pane Workspaces; Pane Chat; Agent-Operable CLI; Installation; Requirements
evidence.finding: Electron desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux running any terminal agent in panes with git worktrees, built-in diff viewer, Remote Pane self-hosted daemon with browser and phone app, runpane CLI and MCP, Loops, Approvals, workspaces across machines; AGPL-3.0.

evidence.title: AGPL-3.0 with additional terms
evidence.finding: GNU AGPL version 3 with the or-later grant, plus Section 7(b) additional terms: visible attribution to Dcouple Inc in the UI and limits on using the foozol and Dcouple names.

evidence.title: RunPane pricing
evidence.finding: Pane is free: no paid plan, seat fee, usage fee or hosted execution subscription; model usage is paid to providers; self-hosted remote machines can have their own cost.

evidence.title: RunPane authentication
evidence.finding: Public website API is read-only without credentials; local Pane actions use the installed runpane CLI and a daemon the user controls; no hosted agent registration.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 656 stars, license NOASSERTION in GitHub (LICENSE file is AGPL-3.0 with additional terms), pushed 2026-11-16, created 2026-02-27, homepage runpane.com.

evidence.title: Pane v2.4.234 release
evidence.finding: Assets: macOS arm64 and x64 dmg/zip, Windows x64 and arm64 exe, Linux x64 and arm64 AppImage and deb, pane-relay binaries for darwin, linux and win32, compose.yaml, checksums; published 2026-11-16.

evidence.title: Architecture index
evidence.finding: Repository, Pane (worktree), Panel (tab) model; renderer React over IPC to main process with SQLite and git; remote PWA and mobile over HTTP and SSE to a daemon; runpane CLI over a socket.

evidence.title: Sessions guide
evidence.locator: Sessions; One Pane per feature; Worker reports; Session inbox; Named locks; Move a Session to another machine
evidence.finding: Named orchestration Sessions with goals, associated Panes, workers reporting to an orchestrator, inbox, named locks, session watcher, move to machine, resume of agent conversations.

evidence.title: Pane MCP server
evidence.finding: runpane mcp stdio and loopback HTTP server registered into Claude Code, Codex and Cursor with toolsets core, agents, panes, panels, workspace, git, sessions, loops, autopilot, repos, devices, machine, secrets.

evidence.title: runpane CLI contract
evidence.finding: Documented commands for repos, panes, panels, agents start/status/send, report, notify, inbox, sessions, lock, loops, pr watch, workspace, machine health, mcp, relay, doctor.

evidence.title: Approvals (Pane Notify)
evidence.locator: What an agent can send; Claude's own prompts; Where approvals are kept
evidence.finding: notify tool shows options, approve, ask, secret and info cards; Claude permission and plan prompts surface in Approvals on desktop, strip and phone; first answer wins.

evidence.title: Loops
evidence.finding: Cron-scheduled loops start a new Pane in a fresh worktree per run or send a prompt to a Session agent; at most once an hour; pause, resume, run now.

evidence.title: Self-hosted remote daemon
evidence.locator: Security Model; SSH route; Current Limitations
evidence.finding: Headless daemon on a VM or workstation as a systemd service with lingering; loopback listener behind Tailscale Serve, SSH forward or HTTPS proxy; connection code carries a bearer token; no multi-tenant auth.

evidence.title: Run your own relay
evidence.finding: Pane relay gives computers an https address; Pane's servers pass the encrypted connection along unread, or users run the open-source pane-relay.

evidence.title: Add a device
evidence.locator: Pair a phone; Link another computer
evidence.finding: QR or one-time link pairs a phone or computer; the iPhone app is in TestFlight by request on Discord; otherwise Pane opens in the phone browser.

evidence.title: Native mobile companion
evidence.finding: Capacitor companion bundling frontend/remote.html for iOS and Android with push alerts; remote hosts are authenticated HTTP/SSE endpoints.

evidence.title: Workspaces
evidence.locator: Who is trusted; Workers on another machine
evidence.finding: Machines on a tailnet reach each other through the CLI; a machine's owner sets who can connect; handoff and workers across machines.

evidence.title: Analytics invariants
evidence.finding: PostHog product analytics on by default for new installs with an opt-out in Privacy Settings, identified by GitHub or git email or install id; disabled by DO_NOT_TRACK or RUNPANE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED.

evidence.title: Chat tabs
evidence.finding: Chat tabs run Claude, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode as ACP conversations without a terminal; context left and tokens used shown per tab.

evidence.title: Machine health
evidence.finding: Per-minute sampling of disk, memory pressure and every process Pane started, credited to its Pane; cleanup of Pane leftovers.

evidence.title: Autopilot (experimental)
evidence.finding: Experimental always-running agent above all Sessions that plans and walks waiting items.

evidence.title: Pane secrets
evidence.finding: Secrets asked on a masked card and used via runpane secrets exec; the value never enters chat.

evidence.title: Export and import your setup
evidence.finding: Settings export to a file of commands, scripts, defaults, shortcuts and choices; keys and tokens are excluded.

evidence.title: Adding a new CLI agent tool
evidence.finding: Agents are entries in contracts/runpane/contract.json; terminal resume and status detection need code per agent.

evidence.title: runpane contract
evidence.finding: Built-in agent entries: claude, codex, cursor, opencode, pi; commands and flags for the CLI.

evidence.title: ACP agent registry
evidence.finding: Reads the ACP Registry index hourly and installs registry agents at pinned versions with checksums.

evidence.title: Analytics manager
evidence.finding: PostHog analytics manager gated by ConfigManager.isAnalyticsEnabled.

evidence.title: Diff panel
evidence.finding: Diff viewer with a PR label and an Open PR button that opens an existing pull request in the browser.

evidence.title: Agent status manifests
evidence.finding: Per-agent status detection of working, blocked and done from terminal output and hooks.

evidence.title: Agent usage service
evidence.finding: Reads agent logs for usage totals shown on the Usage page and leaderboard submission.

evidence.title: Archive cleanup
evidence.finding: Persisted archive cleanup jobs with quarantine, retry and restart recovery.

evidence.title: Bounded search: accounts, roles, SSO
evidence.locator: grep -w for sso, saml, rbac, oidc, scim, organization over main/src, shared, frontend/src, relay, packages
evidence.finding: No accounts, roles, SSO or SCIM; matches are other tools' import code and example agent names.

evidence.title: Bounded search: container or VM isolation
evidence.locator: grep -w for docker, podman, devcontainer, bwrap, seatbelt, firejail over main/src, shared, frontend/src
evidence.finding: No container, VM or OS sandbox isolation; devcontainer.json is only read for setup commands; docker matches are network-adapter filters.

evidence.title: Bounded search: native issue entity
evidence.locator: grep -w for backlog, kanban, jira, linear, epic over main/src, shared, frontend/src
evidence.finding: No issue or ticket entity; Sessions and Panes are work containers and tickets belong to skills and the agent's own tools.

evidence.title: Bounded search: PR creation
evidence.locator: grep for createPullRequest, gh pr create, new pull request over main/src and frontend/src
evidence.finding: No product action that creates a pull request; Pane watches and opens existing PRs.

evidence.title: Bounded search: other triggers
evidence.locator: grep for webhook receiver, github event trigger, cron over main/src
evidence.finding: Cron Loops and PR watch exist; no inbound webhook trigger.
